people.name: Ahab
people.line: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel

translations.web: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it. Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
translations.bsb: So they divided the land to explore. Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went the other way by himself.
